correctness.rationale: The complete 1024-mask census yields 120 four-facets and 496 faces; all 1860 Hasse incidences verify a 238-pair reduced acyclic matching. Its exactly computed 8x12 integral Morse differential has an explicitly checked determinant-one rank-seven minor and a nonzero left-kernel relation, proving seven unit Smith factors. With no cells in dimensions 1/2 or above 4, the attaching maps are classified by the integral degree matrix and cancel to S^3 wedge five S^4. Full boundary ranks in five characteristics independently agree. Proof and code rely on the standalone finite verifier reproduced within this result.

value.rationale: The unique (3,5)-cage and 10-vertex Moore graph has a natural central cut parameter 5. Its pure four-dimensional cut complex unexpectedly has an essential three-dimensional sphere as well as five four-dimensional spheres; this gives a complete integral mixed-dimensional homotopy classification and a nonshellability witness. The precise attaching-map information is absent from Betti-only computation and motivates further filtration and symmetry questions without claiming a general theorem.
